chain_words.nuance: not attractive, but not unpleasant to look at
lacking the qualities that make something appealing
a general description of something unpleasant to look at
so ugly that it is disturbing to see
so unpleasant that it causes disgust

explanation: These words all describe lack of visual appeal, moving from something merely unremarkable to something that provokes disgust.

usage_notes.difference: 'Ugly' is the general word for something unpleasant to look at; 'hideous' suggests a stronger, more disturbing ugliness.
